entities.name: Mr. Orfeo
entities.description: A towering Rhox warrior of the Riveteers in New Capenna, wielding a massive maul.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A family whose agents once ambushed Orfeo.

events.summary: A dozen agents of the Maestros ambush Mr. Orfeo, and the ground is said to still carry their imprints.
events.quote: He was once ambushed by a dozen agents of the Maestros

relations.note: He is a Rhox of the Riveteers.
